name: Commercial Creamery Co.
old_description: Founded in 1908, Commercial Creamery is a leading manufacturer of cheese powders, specialty dairy powders, and seasonings. From our production facility in Jerome, Idaho, we serve thousands of clients in the United States and throughout the world, and export our products to more than 30 countries. Our products are used in a wide range of applications such as snack foods, soups and sauces, dressings and dips, pet foods, beverages, baking, nutraceuticals, entrees, and flavor applications.
about:
Commercial Creamery Company has operated from Jerome, Idaho, since its founding in 1908. The business remains family-owned, now in its fourth generation, and runs its primary manufacturing plant in the Magic Valley region of southern Idaho, where a concentration of dairies provides a steady local supply of milk, cream, and cheese.

The company produces cheese powders, specialty dairy powders, and seasonings, offering custom blending and specialty flavor development. Its technical team supports product development through culinary arts, dairy and flavor chemistry, sensory evaluation, and nutrition analysis. Quality control and assurance programs cover organoleptic, physical, chemical, and microbiological testing across conventional, organic, kosher, halal, gluten-free, and Non-GMO Project Verifiable product lines. The facility serves thousands of clients across the United States and exports to more than 30 countries.

Customers span snack foods, soups and sauces, dressings and dips, pet foods, beverages, baking, nutraceuticals, entrees, and broader flavor applications. The company positions itself as a partner from concept to finished product, emphasizing flexibility in order quantities and rapid response to client needs.

Leadership attributes its longevity to consistent quality, tailored service, and the operational advantage of a fresh, regional dairy supply chain. The operation is SQF certified, FSMA compliant, and operates under HACCP-based risk assessment.
